mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the characteristic used to define hazardous waste as those waste that could cause a fire during transport, storage or disposal."
Ignitability is the characteristic used to define hazardous waste as those waste that could cause a fire during transport, storage or disposal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that do not meet the EPA's definition of hazardous waste - and are not municipal waste."
Non-hazardous industrial wastes are those that do not meet the EPA's definition of hazardous waste - and are not municipal waste.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most widely employed for waste disposal worldwide."
Landfill is the most widely employed for waste disposal worldwide.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a transition metal and exists in several oxidation states, with trivalent Cr3+ and hexavalent Cr6+ species being the most common forms."
Chromium as inorganic pollutant is a transition metal and exists in several oxidation states, with trivalent Cr3+ and hexavalent Cr6+ species being the most common forms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a good fertilizer that can be used to increase soil fertility in long-term basis."
Compost is a good fertilizer that can be used to increase soil fertility in long-term basis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the reduced light penetration and consequent reduction in photosynthesis due to the increased turbidity of water."
A further secondary effect is the reduced light penetration and consequent reduction in photosynthesis due to the increased turbidity of water.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a series of conversions of energy and nutrients as one organism eats another."
A food web is a series of conversions of energy and nutrients as one organism eats another.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as non-air and sewer emission created within and disposed of by a municipality including household garbage, commercial refuse, construction and demolition debris, dead animals and abandoned vehicles."

Municipal solid waste (MSW) can be defined as non-air and sewer emission created within and disposed of by a municipality including household garbage, commercial refuse, construction and demolition debris, dead animals and abandoned vehicles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a growing problem worldwide and is directly connected to industrial development and population growth."
Waste generation and disposal is a growing problem worldwide and is directly connected to industrial development and population growth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a subgroup of solid waste commonly found in MSW as well as in wastewater streams."
Household Hazardous Waste is a subgroup of solid waste commonly found in MSW as well as in wastewater streams.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the way that individual soil mineral particles (sand, silt, and clay) are arranged and grouped in space."
Soil structure refers to the way that individual soil mineral particles (sand, silt, and clay) are arranged and grouped in space.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in irrigation to grow crops such as lettuce, tomato, onions and so forth."
The same wastewaters are used in irrigation to grow crops such as lettuce, tomato, onions and so forth.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any material produced originally by living organisms (plant or animal) that is returned to the soil and goes through the decomposition process."
Soil organic matter is any material produced originally by living organisms (plant or animal) that is returned to the soil and goes through the decomposition process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most widespread mycorrhizal fungi."
Vesicular-arbuscular mycorrhizae are the most widespread mycorrhizal fungi.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the toxic effects that have rapid onset, a short course and pronounced symptoms."
Acute toxicity refers to the toxic effects that have rapid onset, a short course and pronounced symptoms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the thermal degradation of organic waste in the absence of oxygen to produce a carbonaceous char, oil and combustible gases."
Pyrolysis is the thermal degradation of organic waste in the absence of oxygen to produce a carbonaceous char, oil and combustible gases.
